claim.summary: Over any field, a finite paid source representation E_0 injects into ... into E_B with nonzero mark u in E_0, compatible commuting variable maps E_b->E_(b+1), and original source generators killing u, equipped with a finite increasing auxiliary filtration preserved by all actions and strict for degree inclusions, yields a source-compatible marked cyclic representation on one auxiliary associated-graded component at the same cutoff B. Take the first filtration index containing u; strictness preserves its nonzero graded image and injective degree maps, so the terminal evaluation kernel is a proper PC pseudoideal containing the source. Thus fixed diagonal components lacking any joint cyclic witness cannot gain one via such strict triangular corrections. This is necessary only: no converse lifting, automatic strictness, or general nilpotent obstruction is asserted.

claim.summary: For the full Boolean algebra on m>=1 fresh bits over F2, coefficient dual basis e_H, actual multiplication M_i e_H=1_(i in H)(e_H+e_(H-i)), and D_i e_H=1_(i in H)e_H, the incidence map Z e_H=sum_(S subset H)e_S satisfies Z^2=I, (Z-I)^2=0, M_i=Z D_i Z, and is the unique invertible binary intertwiner for these labelled actions. Strict subface operators form a nilpotent ideal of index at most m+1. The transpose sends r_S to r_S product_(j notin S)(1+r_j), of exact multilinear degree m; in particular (Z lambda)(1)=lambda(product_j(1+r_j)). On the complete accuracy-m unit-input block, every normalized full Boolean source annihilator is therefore sent to zero on the unchanged unit. This controls that active correction, not coordinate changes with transported tests or all nilpotent lifting methods.
